claims.statement: The policy is optimized for sampled objective costs instead of supervised tour likelihood.
A masked LSTM pointer decoder constructs feasible TSP tours; a glimpse supplies additional attention computation.
Active search updates parameters on one test instance using a moving-average baseline, and can start from pretrained or random parameters.
TSP100 greedy length 8.30 and pretrained-AS length 7.83 use very different budgets; the AS 1280000-sample budget is reported as 12000 seconds.
The authors report all tested knapsack instances solved optimally by active search after 5000 updates; no general exactness theorem is given.
Simple masking cannot decide feasibility for every problem; time windows and penalties are discussed as challenges/future work.
Framework adaptation to knapsack is not evidence for one jointly trained TSP/knapsack checkpoint.
The reviewed manuscript promises TensorFlow code but gives no author-maintained learned-policy repository link.
The author-hosted five-page Workshop Track paper includes its own appendix and TSP tables, while the longer arXiv has additional critic/knapsack material; these are distinct identified versions.
